items.title: Orrin Evans interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: You know, Red Garland and Wynton Kelly and then Bill Evans and so forth.

ctx.x: There’s been a lot of instances over the years in jazz where one player gets replaced by another. You know, Red Garland and Wynton Kelly and then Bill Evans and so forth. And I’ve noticed a bit of press about you joining the Bad Plus and it seems to be worthy of press. How do you feel about stepping into a group that’s been together for, you know, quite a few years.

Well first, everything, not everything, sorry let me take that back. First there’s a lot of things out there that are worthy of press that just don’t get it. And one of those things could be Orrin Evans you know. I’ve been here twenty years doing this. And now there’s tons of press about me joining the Bad Plus. Now there’s promoters and agents that want to call up. Or now, every advertisement, even one for this one is like “the Bad Plus pianist.” They even had to put the picture of the Bad Plus up on the…
